I do intermittent fasting, because it works for me (8:16). I started about 8 years ago when I was trying to lose those last 10-15lbs, and it just stuck with me. I also work a very busy and physical job, and if I eat too much during the workday, I'll slow down a lot. Every once in a while I'll take a day off from eating, too. Other days, like holidays, I'll feast all day long.

It's not for everyone, and a lot of people think I'm weird, but I don't care.
